prompts.display_text: Pin a country or territory where a new temple was dedicated from 1987 through 1998 (not counting rededications).
prompts.text_original: Pin a country or territory where a new temple was dedicated from 1987 through 1998 (not counting rededications).
prompts.summary: Only five countries and territories saw a new temple dedicated from 1987 through 1998: Frankfurt in 1987, Toronto in 1990, Hong Kong in 1996 and Preston, England, in 1998, plus nine in the United States. The wave of smaller temples began with Monticello, Utah, in 1998.

answers.name: United States of America
answers.fact: Bountiful Utah, 1995; Las Vegas Nevada, 1989; Monticello Utah, 1998; and 6 more.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country or territory whose first temple was announced between 2022 and 2025.
prompts.text_original: Pin a country or territory whose first temple was announced between 2022 and 2025.
prompts.summary: From 2022 to 2025 first temples were announced for the Republic of the Congo, Indonesia, Mongolia, Angola, Ireland, Uganda and New Caledonia. Brazzaville is under construction; the others were announced but not yet under construction as of October 2026.

answers.name: Republic of the Congo
answers.fact: Brazzaville Republic of the Congo, announced 2022.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country Russell M. Nelson dedicated for the preaching of the gospel in September 2010
prompts.text_original: In September 2010 Elder Russell M. Nelson of the Quorum of the Twelve traveled through the former Yugoslavia and dedicated six lands for the preaching of the gospel. A country he dedicated on that trip.
prompts.summary: In one September 2010 journey Russell M. Nelson, then an Apostle, offered dedicatory prayers in six lands of the former Yugoslavia: Croatia, Slovenia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Kosovo and Macedonia. It was one of many such prayers he offered across Eastern Europe and Central Asia.

answers.name: North Macedonia
answers.fact: Dedicated for preaching in September 2010, then called Macedonia.

prompts.display_text: Pin a Northern European country dedicated or rededicated for preaching the gospel between 1977 and 1998
prompts.text_original: Long after the first Scandinavian missions, Church leaders offered new dedicatory prayers across Northern Europe. A country in Northern Europe (the Nordic and Baltic countries, the United Kingdom and Ireland) that a Church leader dedicated or rededicated for the preaching of the gospel between 1977 and 1998.
prompts.note: Only Ireland counts. The 1985 dedication of the whole island was given in Northern Ireland; the United Kingdom had none.
prompts.summary: Between 1977 and 1998 Church leaders dedicated or rededicated six Northern European lands. Joseph B. Wirthlin dedicated Iceland in 1977 and Neal A. Maxwell dedicated Ireland in 1985. As the Soviet Union opened, Apostles dedicated Estonia in 1990 and Latvia and Lithuania in 1993, and Thomas S. Monson rededicated Denmark in 1998.

answers.name: Denmark
answers.fact: Thomas S. Monson of the First Presidency rededicated Denmark in 1998.

answers.name: Ireland
answers.fact: Elder Neal A. Maxwell dedicated Ireland near the site of the first Irish baptism, October 23, 1985.

answers.name: Estonia
answers.fact: Elder Russell M. Nelson dedicated Estonia above the Tallinn song festival grounds, April 25, 1990.

answers.name: Iceland
answers.fact: Elder Joseph B. Wirthlin, then a Seventy, dedicated Iceland from Oskjuhlid in Reykjavik, September 18, 1977.

answers.name: Lithuania
answers.fact: Elder M. Russell Ballard dedicated Lithuania in Vilnius, February 20, 1993.

answers.name: Latvia
answers.fact: Elder James E. Faust dedicated Latvia at Jurmala, March 17, 1993.

prompts.display_text: Pin a Northern European country whose first stake was organized between 1960 and 1977
prompts.text_original: Stakes came to Europe in 1960 and spread north over the next two decades. A country in Northern Europe (the Nordic and Baltic countries, the United Kingdom and Ireland) whose first stake was organized between 1960 and 1977.
prompts.note: Ireland's first stake came in 1995. Belfast's 1974 stake is in the United Kingdom, which already had stakes.
prompts.summary: Europe's first stake was organized in Manchester, England, in 1960. Scandinavia followed in the 1970s: Copenhagen in 1974, Stockholm in 1975, and Oslo and Helsinki in 1977. Ireland waited until 1995, and Iceland and the Baltic states still have districts rather than stakes as of October 2026.

answers.name: United Kingdom
answers.fact: The Manchester England Stake, the first stake in Europe, was organized March 27, 1960.

answers.name: Denmark
answers.fact: The Copenhagen Denmark Stake, the first in Scandinavia, was organized June 16, 1974.

answers.name: Sweden
answers.fact: The Stockholm Sweden Stake was organized April 20, 1975.

answers.name: Norway
answers.fact: The Oslo Norway Stake, Norway's first, was created May 22, 1977.

answers.name: Finland
answers.fact: The Helsinki Finland Stake, Finland's first, was organized October 16, 1977.
